text: How do we know a new merchant really owns the email they typed?
prefix: How do we know a new merchant really owns the email they typed?

text: Anyone can type any address, so a sign-up alone proves nothing.
prefix: Anyone can type any address, so a sign-up alone proves nothing.

text: So the partner module saves the merchant as pending, and sends a one-time code to that email.
prefix: So the partner module saves the merchant as pending, and sends a one-time code to that email.

text: The code lives in Redis with a configured lifetime, and disappears when it expires.
prefix: The code lives in Redis with a configured lifetime, and disappears when it expires.

text: The email goes out through the email port, and locally it lands in Mailpit, where we can open it.
prefix: The email goes out through the email port, and locally it lands in Mailpit, where we can open it.

text: The merchant types the code back, and only then is the email marked as verified.
prefix: The merchant types the code back, and only then is the email marked as verified.

text: Wrong codes count against a configured limit, and too many lock the attempt.
prefix: Wrong codes count against a configured limit, and too many lock the attempt.

text: Resends are limited too, so nobody can flood an inbox.
prefix: Resends are limited too, so nobody can flood an inbox.

text: Every failure returns a clear error with a code, never a stack trace.
prefix: Every failure returns a clear error with a code, never a stack trace.

text: Next, the merchant moves through a lifecycle, from pending to active.
